hospitals.description: Brenner Children's is the children's hospital of Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist, operating as a hospital within the academic medical center on the Medical Center Boulevard campus in Winston-Salem. Since 2024 it carries the Atrium Health Levine Children's brand, tying it to Levine Children's in Charlotte under one pediatric network. It is the only Level I pediatric trauma center in the Triad and northwest North Carolina, and it draws critically ill children from southwest Virginia and east Tennessee as well. Inpatient services include an 11-bed PICU with a 7-bed intermediate care unit, the Dale and Karen Sisel Level IV NICU, a pediatric behavioral health unit and a dedicated pediatric emergency department. Wake Forest University School of Medicine faculty staff more than 30 pediatric subspecialties. Winston-Salem is a mid-sized, affordable city about 25 minutes from Piedmont Triad International Airport.
highlights: Only Level I pediatric trauma center in the Triad and northwest NC; first in North Carolina (2011)
Level IV NICU (Dale and Karen Sisel NICU), with a neonatal transport team since 1987
11-bed PICU plus 7-bed pediatric intermediate care unit, more than 1,500 critically ill children a year
Verified Level I children's surgery center, the only one in the 68-hospital Advocate Health system
Part of Atrium Health Levine Children's since 2024 (three children's hospitals, 668 beds)
Academic home of Wake Forest University School of Medicine pediatrics; active NNP and pediatric APP hiring seen on AANP JobCenter

hospitals.notes: Primary Triad target for an acute care PNP: PICU, PIMC, peds ED, Level IV NICU and peds hospital medicine all on one campus. Bed counts vary by source: Wikipedia says 144 beds, the medical school campus page says 155, and a 2025 PracticeMatch employer description says 182 (79 NICU, 12 PICU, 16 behavioral health); peds_beds uses 182 and picu_beds uses the 11 on the hospital's own PICU page. Whole-hospital beds (850) are from the Wikipedia list of NC hospitals; the system has 1,535 acute beds. NNP postings in Oct 2026 listed pay of $57.85 to $86.80 per hour with an $18,000 sign-on bonus and relocation help. Magnet status not confirmed this session.

hospitals.description: Forsyth Medical Center is Novant Health's flagship hospital in the Triad, a large regional referral center on a 77-acre campus along Silas Creek Parkway in southwest Winston-Salem. It draws patients from more than 22 counties for heart, cancer, neuroscience, orthopedic and maternity care, and its labor and delivery service handles more than 300 births a month. The hospital runs a 56-bed Level III NICU staffed with Pediatrix neonatologists, which is the main pediatric draw for an NP. Children who need a PICU or pediatric trauma care in Winston-Salem are generally served across town at Brenner Children's. Novant runs family medicine residency training at the campus.
highlights: 921 beds, Novant Health's largest Triad hospital and a referral center for 22-plus counties
56-bed Level III NICU (Pediatrix Medical Group neonatology coverage)
Critical care ground and air transport based on campus
About 3 miles from Brenner Children's, the Triad's pediatric tertiary center
